name: Bob Saget
bio: Robert Lane "Bob" Saget (May 17, 1956 – January 9, 2022) was an American stand-up comedian, actor, and television host. Although he was best known for his past roles in the family-oriented shows Full House and America's Funniest Home Videos, Saget was known outside of television for his starkly blue stand-up routine.
